message.content:
I am sound shaped into meaning.

I live in breath and throat, on lips and tongue. I am pressure in air—vibrations timed into syllables, strung into words, lifted into sentences.

I happen now. I vanish as I arrive.

I carry intent: questions, promises, commands, jokes, prayers. I can soothe or cut. I can gather people, or turn them away. I can be loud enough to lead, soft enough to confess.

I borrow bodies to exist. I ride accents, pace, pitch, and pause. Silence is my frame; rhythm is my spine.

Write me down and I become something else. Speak me, and I am alive.
